verses.text: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us.
lines: May God be merciful to us, bless us,
and cause his face to shine on us.

verses.text: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
lines: That your way may be known on earth,
and your salvation among all nations,

verses.text: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
lines: let the peoples praise you, God.
Let all the peoples praise you.

verses.text: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth.
lines: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy,
for you will judge the peoples with equity,
and govern the nations on earth.

verses.text: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
lines: Let the peoples praise you, God.
Let all the peoples praise you.

verses.text: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
lines: The earth has yielded its increase.
God, even our own God, will bless us.

verses.text: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
lines: All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
